capability_leases_scope_check.name: capability_leases_scope_check
capability_leases_scope_check.value: ("capability_leases"."scope_kind" = 'account' AND "capability_leases"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("capability_leases"."scope_kind" = 'project' AND "capability_leases"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

capability_leases_state_check.name: capability_leases_state_check
capability_leases_state_check.value: ("capability_leases"."status" = 'active' AND "capability_leases"."remaining_uses" > 0 AND "capability_leases"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("capability_leases"."status" = 'revoked' AND "capability_leases"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("capability_leases"."status" = 'depleted' AND "capability_leases"."remaining_uses" = 0 AND "capability_leases"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
